title: The veil removed and priestly garments as mysteries
english: Paul says that the veil is removed for those converted to the Lord (2 Corinthians 3:16). The garments of the high priest do not cover bare history; they cover the mysteries of Christ and the church.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is introducing the spiritual reading of the high priest's vestments, citing Paul that the veil is removed for those converted to the Lord.

title: The linen tunic and the new priest
english: The linen tunic worn against the skin is interior chastity. The common man is a slave to sins; the new priest is clothed with Christ.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is interpreting the high priest's garments spiritually, applying each item to the moral life of the believer.

title: The high priest bears the people on shoulders and heart
english: The shoulder-piece and the breastpiece of judgment: the burdens of the people on his shoulders, the names in his heart. The high priest is mindful of the church.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is interpreting the high priest's vestments, specifically the shoulder-piece and the breastpiece of judgment, as figures of the priest's care for the people.

title: Bells and pomegranates on the priestly robe
english: Bells and pomegranates along the hem of the garment: the sound of teaching and the fruit of works. When he enters the holy place, let him be heard.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is interpreting the high priest's vestments from Exodus, applying each item to the moral and doctrinal life of the Christian teacher.

title: The golden plate on the forehead
english: The golden plate on the forehead: Holy to the Lord (Exodus 28:36). The thought on the forehead consecrated. Every captivity into the obedience of Christ (2 Corinthians 10:5).
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is interpreting the high priest's vestments, and now explains the golden plate worn on the forehead.

title: Clothing the priests with glory and beauty
english: Clothe the priests for glory and beauty. The glory of the soul is virtue; its beauty is the order of love. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is concluding his moral application of the priestly vestments, addressing the soul of the believer as priest.
